rate_limits: Maximum one request per second for valhalla1.openstreetmap.de.
resolution_notes: rate_limits: Corrected. The current official FOSSGIS terms explicitly apply to valhalla1.openstreetmap.de and impose a maximum of one request per second. The older 100-requests-per-second total figure is not stated in the current terms. Evidence: https://fossgis.de/arbeitsgruppen/osm-server/nutzungsbedingungen/
